# Fukuii

> Fukuii is a Scala execution client for the Ethereum Virtual Machine ecosystem: the only actively-developed native client for Ethereum Classic, the only Proof-of-Work EVM network, and a full-featured client for Ethereum's Proof-of-Stake networks.

Fukuii is a Scala EVM execution client, maintained by Chippr Robotics LLC. One binary runs Ethereum
Classic (chain 61), Ethereum mainnet (chain 1), Mordor testnet (chain 63), and Sepolia (chain
11155111) from a single deployment, each network fully isolated: its own state, its own metrics
registry, its own config.

## Why Fukuii

### The Only PoW EVM

Ethereum Classic is the only Proof-of-Work EVM network in production. core-geth is deprecated;
Besu has exited ETC support. Fukuii is ETC's successor client, built independently on the same
EIPs and wire protocol as every other EVM client, not forked from or transpiled out of any of them.

### One Binary, Every Network

Fukuii is the only EVM client built to run multiple networks concurrently in one process. No other
client isolates metrics, storage, and config per instance the way Fukuii does.

### The Preferred Stack

A type system that rejects consensus bugs before they reach a block. Fukuii runs on the JVM, the
runtime trading desks and clearing systems have trusted for decades, and Scala 3's type system
makes entire classes of consensus-critical bugs impossible to express, caught at compile time.

### Agentic Infrastructure

Fukuii ships a built-in MCP server that exposes node state, sync progress, peer counts, and block
data to any MCP-compatible agent: one of a very small number of EVM clients with a native
agentic-AI interface.

## Mining Economy

Fukuii is built with the mining economy as its flagship use case. Mining-pool-grade
getWork/submitWork with verify-before-ack, ECIP-1099 seedHash/DAG-epoch handling, a named
mining-pool deployment profile (SNAP-serving on, tip-server sync), and BitTorrent-based state
distribution that turns pools into snapshot seeders for the whole network.

## Regulated Finance

Pure JVM-native infrastructure for trading systems and custody platforms already running on the
JVM: no FFI bridge, signed container images with build provenance attestation and a CycloneDX
SBOM, concurrent multi-instance execution, and external-signer/HSM custody integration.

## Supported Networks

- Ethereum Classic (chain 61): the only Proof-of-Work EVM network, PoW/ETChash, full SNAP sync, Olympia (Fusaka)
- Mordor (chain 63): ETC PoW testnet
- Ethereum Mainnet (chain 1): the largest Proof-of-Stake network, PoS via Engine API
- Sepolia (chain 11155111): ETH PoS testnet

The same network-family framework also hosts, configurable per deployment: PoA consortium and
private networks (Clique/Qbft/Bor-style), sidechains (Polygon/Bor-style), L2 rollups
(OP-stack/Taiko-style), and ZK-EVM/alt-consensus families.

## Runtime Stack

- Language: Scala 3 LTS, kept current with each LTS patch release
- JDK: current JDK LTS
- Actor system: Apache Pekko (Apache Software Foundation, no BSL)
- Storage: RocksDB, tracked to the latest stable release
- Effects: Cats Effect 3 + fs2 (fully migrated off Monix)
- Signed build provenance: Cosign keyless signing on every release
- CycloneDX SBOM on all release artifacts

## Operations

Three isolated Pekko dispatchers keep sync pressure from starving the RPC. Prometheus metrics,
Grafana dashboards, and liveness endpoints ship in the binary. A dRPC-Provider gRPC bridge and a
named RPC-relay deployment profile make Fukuii a clean upstream for aggregation gateways.

## Hardware Requirements

- Home node: 8 GB RAM, 500 GB disk
- Professional: 16 GB RAM, 1 TB disk
- Enterprise: 32–64 GB RAM, 2–4 TB disk
- Archive: 64 GB+ RAM, 4 TB+ disk

## Quick Start

    docker run ghcr.io/chippr-robotics/fukuii mordor
